business_summary.text: Laxmi Dental Limited is a dental products and services company operating through laboratory, aligners, and other dental businesses.

call_points.text: Company is debt-free with cash and investments of about ₹99 Cr; FY26 capex was about ₹18.4 Cr.
No numeric FY27 guidance was given; management highlighted growth opportunities across segments.
Dental Laboratory business grew 27% YoY, driven by domestic recovery and record international revenue.
Aligner Solutions revenue was ₹18 Cr; Bizdent grew 11% YoY and Vedia was flat sequentially at ₹7 Cr.
Higher US tariffs had a 74 bps impact on Q4 EBITDA and 72 bps on FY26.
Vedia saw order delays in March due to higher freight costs from geopolitical uncertainties.

operating_notes.text: Aligners segment Q4FY26 profit of ₹62.31 Cr was 43% of its full-year ₹144.37 Cr, against ₹14.35 Cr in Q4FY25.
IPO proceeds of ₹1,281.70 million were 57% utilised as of 31 March 2026; extension sought for balance.
Digital penetration in the Indian dental business stands at ~80%.
Laxmi Dental has employed more than 160 intraoral scanners in India.
Aligner Solutions revenue grew ~8x over FY22-26 to ₹39.5 Cr.
Domestic lab digital penetration is about 80%, with a medium-term target of over 90%.
Export revenue is about 33-34% of total, with the US at 20% of revenue.
Scanner deployments were 211 in Q4FY26 and 1,009 in FY26.
Digital penetration in domestic markets is approximately 75-80%.
Scanner deployments target for FY27 is 800-1,000 units.
Average cost per scanner is approximately ₹3 lakhs.
Subsidiary Laxmi Dental Lab USA, INC received tariff refund of US$ 0.63 million (~₹5.92 Cr) from U.S. Customs and Border Protection.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹73.95 Cr (+21.9% YoY), net profit ₹10.1 Cr (+136.0% YoY).
Laxmi Dental reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹74 Cr (+21.9% YoY) and FY26 revenue of ₹278 Cr (+16.2% YoY), with FY26 PAT down 9.2% on one-time charges.
Laxmi Dental Limited uploaded the Q4FY26 earnings conference call recording on May 22, 2026, hosted by Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited.
Laxmi Dental Q4FY26 revenue rose 22% YoY to ₹74 Cr; EBITDA margin up to 18.3%
Laxmi Dental Limited held its Q1FY27 earnings conference call on August 12, 2026, reporting record quarterly revenue of ₹75 Cr, a 13.9% YoY increase, with EBITDA margin improving to 19.2%.
Laxmi Dental's US subsidiary received a US$ 0.63 million (~₹5.92 Cr) tariff refund from US Customs.

status_history.evidence: Bizdent aligners grew 10.9% YoY in Q4FY26; Vedia revenue was ₹7.3 Cr, with some March shipments delayed by higher freight.
Aligners segment revenue grew 28.6% YoY, but specific revenue figure not disclosed.
